visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at a bustling outdoor market stall at eye-level. Multiple customers, including an elderly woman in a floral shirt and a woman in a red apron (vendor), are gathered around a large display of assorted braised foods. Stainless steel trays are filled with brown-braised intestines, eggs, and meat. Bright, flat daylight illuminates the scene. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a male vendor wearing a black mask and plastic gloves. He is using a heavy cleaver to chop pieces of braised tofu on a round wooden cutting board. His movements are precise and rhythmic. Behind him, other vendors are busy preparing food in a brightly lit indoor/outdoor kitchen area. (3) A series of close-up shots highlight various food items: a metal bowl being filled with glistening, dark-brown braised intestines using tongs, and shots of pork skin and other meat products. The lighting highlights the oily, succulent texture of the food. (4) The vendor is shown weighing a metal bowl of food on a green digital scale before transferring the contents to a plastic bag. He then adds a spoonful of chili oil and tops the bag with chopped scallions and pickled vegetables. (5) Several plates of thinly sliced, reddish-brown smoked goose are shown, wrapped in clear plastic. A hand uses chopsticks to lift a single slice of goose, showing its texture against the background of the market. (6) The video concludes with wide shots of the stall, featuring a prominent red and yellow sign that reads '888 正宗滷味'. Several customers are seen queuing and interacting with the staff under the bright market lights.
